immutability_policy: All v1.0 evidence artifacts are immutable. No edits, no re-executions in place, no status updates. Supersession states describe how v1.0 evidence may be used in v1.1 context. Historical supersession records are preserved as historical truth: a SUPERSEDED or HISTORICAL_ONLY artifact must never be presented as current authority by any current evidence index.

supersession_states.CURRENT: The evidence is native current v1.1 evidence, produced from live canonical qualification/freeze artifacts. Not inherited from v1.0 and not eligible for silent supersession.
supersession_states.REUSE_INVARIANT_ONLY: The invariant/architecture is unchanged. v1.0 code may be cited but v1.1 must supply its own runtime evidence (log, trace, Merkle proof) at the v1.1 evidence level.
supersession_states.REEXECUTE_UNCHANGED: The test/proof is re-executed in the v1.1 environment without source changes. New evidence artifact references the original proof_id with an updated execution hash.
supersession_states.REEXECUTE_WITH_ADAPTER: The proof requires adapter code (e.g., new provider signature format, new delivery topology). Re-executed with minimal changes. Original proof_id preserved with -v1.1 suffix.
supersession_states.HISTORICAL_ONLY: The evidence documented a v1.0-specific capability that does not exist in v1.1. Retained for historical reference only. Not admissible for v1.1 claims.
supersession_states.INVALIDATED: The evidence artifact has been reviewed and found invalid. Must not be cited for any claim. See review_record for details.

current_baseline.note: Current v1.1 frozen-green baselines. These are the only current authority for their scopes. Older artifacts remain historical truth under their recorded states; they must not be promoted to current authority.

entries.v1.1_reason: The prior v1.1 manifest carried evidence_scope=china_market_strategy as the effective global baseline scope. That scoping was stale: it predated the L1/L2/Traffic frozen-green baselines. The global current baseline scope is sandbox_ci; China-market evidence is retained as a subordinate capability (china-market-strategy) with its own bounded statuses and non-claims. This entry preserves the historical fact that the china-scoped manifest was correct at its checkpoint; it must not be restored as the global scope.
